description:
A silent 3D mini-story: a man sits on a bollard in a cobbled square while a steaming pie waits in a window just out of reach. The bollard has plans of its own, and it stretches up to the sill.
Fiction made with AI-assisted tools. Original 3D animation; nothing here is real footage or a real event.
Character animations: Mixamo.
Did the bollard deserve that pie? Tell us in the comments and subscribe for the next story.
